literal_anchor: paramedics administering resuscitation to an unconscious swimmer until breathing and consciousness return
selection_logic: The sentence entails a critical rescue procedure where paramedics apply focused physical effort to bring an unresponsive drowning victim back to life. Shot 1 provides a compact environmental baseline on the shoreline. Shot 2 raises the narrative weight through urgent bodily effort as the paramedics position equipment and begin CPR. Shot 3 narrows to the central mechanical act: locked hands exerting vertical compressions on the chest. Shot 4 delivers the dominant payoff beat where the swimmer coughs up aspirated water and resumes unassisted breathing. Visual weight rises continuously from setup to physiological payoff.
